subject: BlueWave: Redwood demo — confirm CTO presence and times
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Hart <sam.hart@bluewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: BlueWave: Redwood demo — proposed windows & VP/CTO attendance

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We’d love to run a 45-minute demo of the Redwood inference platform focused on: low-latency inference, predictable dedicated capacity, and the routing/fallback playbook for multi-region deployments. Would Marcus (CTO) or your VP of Engineering be available to join? We find having one senior technical sponsor in the room makes the technical Q&A far more efficient.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed, Jun 30 — 10:00–10:45
- Thu, Jul 1 — 14:00–14:45

If neither works, tell me a couple of times that do. I’ve attached a short deck to give Marcus a quick pre-read.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)

Next steps: if you confirm a slot, we’ll tentatively request VP-level coverage from our side and set up a 15-min prebrief with the attending BlueWave lead.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Vanessa —

Thanks for the note and the deck — useful. Marcus is traveling the week of Jun 30 and won’t be back until Jul 2. Our VP of Engineering is out Friday. Can you do Tue, Jul 6 at 11:00 PT? If Marcus can’t make the live demo, he may join a recording review with questions afterwards. Also, can you confirm whether a Redwood technical exec (VP/Head of Product or similar) can attend to cover strategic roadmap/questions?

Sam Hart
